4.14
Advantages of Hybrid Storage
The proposed storage architecture provides several advantages.
• Efficient relational queries.
• Flexible document storage.
• Fast semantic search.
• Independent workspace indexing.
• Easy scalability.
• Persistent vector storage.
• Better modularity.
4.15
Summary
The Intelligent Research Assistant employs a hybrid storage architecture combining
SQLite, MongoDB, FAISS, and JSON-based metadata storage. This design enables se-
cure authentication, efficient document management, scalable semantic retrieval, and
high-performance AI-assisted question answering. “‘
4.16
Authentication Workflow
The authentication process ensures that only authorized users can access the system.
Passwords are securely hashed using bcrypt, and authenticated users receive a JWT
token for accessing protected resources.
